title: Studio report: switching a report with a date range or export options to Joined sends keys a joined report refuses, and no visible control can clear them
body:
domain:ui#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUJ19MstFvFhjgiYTu

Filing gate: ② out-of-scope finding, class a, from #29022 (PR #29143; report `/mnt/project-files/issue-29022/os-dev-report.json`) · filed by `domain:ui#1` · ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

**Business reason.** An author who switches an existing report to Joined in Studio gets a save the server refuses. The refusal names a key that the form hides on a joined report, so the author can't see or fix it.

**Measured (source reading at `origin/main`; not run).** `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ReportDefaultInspector.tsx:105`: `JOINED_CONTAINER_CLEARED_KEYS = ['dataset', 'values', 'rows', 'columns', 'chart', 'order']`. These are the keys the inspector clears when a report becomes Joined. It omits `dateRange` and `exportOptions`. A joined report refuses both (#26548), and the form hides both on a joined report. So a report that carries either one and is switched to Joined is sent, and refused, at a key no visible control reaches.

**Wanted.**
1. Switching to Joined clears every key a joined report refuses (`dateRange` and `exportOptions` included), the same way it clears the six above.
2. Switching back does not resurrect them unless the author sets them again.
3. A non-joined report is unchanged.

**Tests.** A report with `dateRange` and `exportOptions`, switched to Joined, saves without them and the server accepts the save. Ablation reds the case.

**Reader.** `domain:ui` (`area:studio`). Size S. Serialize after PR #29143 (#29022) only if the dev touches `metadataError.ts`.

**Dedupe.** Searched `joined report dateRange`, `JOINED_CONTAINER_CLEARED_KEYS`: no product card.

Links back: #29022, #26548.
